digest_semantics: SHA256 sorted compact UTF8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; exclude only content_digest. This receipt includes local locator context; native/source identity remains separately pinned and path-independent. Content identity only, not authenticity or authority.

tooling_observation.export_only: uv export --locked --offline --all-extras --no-emit-project --python <existing CyberPilot interpreter> --no-managed-python; task-specific UV_CACHE_DIR. Parser selection is NOT a native build interpreter/profile override.

blockers.detail: Root modeld SCons enumerates constructor-backed GPU/device probes. CPU fallback or DEV=CPU does not establish no device access attempts; conditional PCI paths can write sysfs if exposed/privileged. No probe run.
Static rejection at a reachable forbidden-device boundary; remaining transitive imports/actions are NOT approved by omission.
Image/Python-managed/host compiler/LLVM/system snapshot artifacts not selected or acquired; no complete build-input closure claim.
Raw sources/release wheels and backend candidates acquired only. No shim hook, spidev compilation, cache preparation, installed-version/local-SCM-version verification or offline uv sync.
